If Phase 27 built the brain and Phase 28 is building the nervous system, then the Enterprise Operations Center is the eyes, ears, and command bridge.

sections.title: 📈 Overall Documentation Progress
paragraphs: At this point, the documentation is approximately 98–99% complete.

What remains are the final enterprise-wide finishing phases—bringing together lifecycle management, extensibility, operational maturity, and the architectural blueprint that turns KoreVity from a complete Enterprise Operating System into a production-ready enterprise platform specification.
These last phases are fewer in number but critically important because they define how the entire system evolves, is governed, and is sustained over years of enterprise operation.
